_meta.description: Sample Jira-format issues with acceptance criteria for testing the AC Quality Ranker agent before connecting to real Jira.
_meta.field_explanation: acceptanceCriteria can be a plain string (inline), an array of strings (one per criterion), or parsed from description. The agent normalises all to text for scoring.
_meta.source: Synthetic — covers Excellent, Good, Needs Work, and Poor quality levels

acceptanceCriteria: Scenario: Successful password reset. Given I am on the login page, when I click 'Forgot Password' and enter my registered email and submit, then a password reset link is sent to that email within 30 seconds.
Scenario: Invalid email. Given I am on the forgot-password page, when I enter an email not registered in the system and submit, then I see an error message 'No account found with this email'.

Scenario: Expired token. Given I have a password reset token older than 15 minutes, when I click the reset link, then the token is rejected and I am redirected to request a new reset link with a message 'This reset link has expired. Please request a new one.'

Scenario: Successful password set. Given I have a valid reset token, when I enter a new password meeting the policy (min 8 chars, 1 uppercase, 1 digit) and confirm it and submit, then my password is updated and I am redirected to the login page with a success banner 'Password updated successfully'.
Given I am viewing a dashboard with at least one widget, when I click the 'Export as PDF' button, then the system generates a PDF of the visible dashboard viewport.
The PDF file name should be 'dashboard-export-{current-date}.pdf'.
Given a dashboard with no data, when I export to PDF, then the PDF shows the dashboard layout with empty-state placeholders instead of erroring out.
The export must complete within 5 seconds for dashboards with up to 12 widgets.
Given the PDF generation is in progress, when I click 'Export' again, then the second request is queued and I see a toast 'Export already in progress'.
Users should be able to upload a profile picture easily and it should look good.
Image should be reasonably sized.
Make sure it works on mobile too.
If something goes wrong, show an error.

Scenario: Within rate limit. Given a client with a valid API key, when they send fewer than 100 requests per minute to /api/v1/search, then every request returns a 200 OK response and the response headers include X-RateLimit-Remaining with the correct count.

Scenario: Rate limit exceeded. Given a client who has sent 100 requests in the current 60-second sliding window, when they send the 101st request, then the API returns HTTP 429 and the response body contains a JSON object with 'error': 'rate_limit_exceeded' and 'retry_after_seconds' indicating the wait time.

Scenario: Rate limit resets. Given a client who received a 429 response, when they wait for the duration specified in retry_after_seconds and retry, then the request is processed normally and a 200 OK is returned.
Given an API key that has been revoked, when the client sends any request to any endpoint, then the API returns 401 Unauthorised with no rate-limit headers.
System sends a welcome email immediately after user registration.
If the user has not completed their profile within 24 hours, send a reminder email.
If the user has not logged in for 3 days since registration, send a re-engagement email with a link to a getting-started guide.
All emails must include an unsubscribe link in the footer and respect the user's email opt-in preference.
Given the user has opted out of marketing emails, when any trigger event fires, then no marketing email is sent but transactional emails (welcome) are still delivered.

Scenario: Email bounces. Given the user's email address hard-bounces, when the system receives the bounce notification, then the user's email subscription status is set to 'bounced' and no further emails are sent.
Add more filters to the search page so users can narrow down results.
Make the filters fast and responsive.
Users should have a good experience when using the filters.
Test all major browsers.

Scenario: Admin modifies user role. Given an admin user with 'super-admin' role, when they change another user's role from 'viewer' to 'editor', then an audit entry is created recording admin ID, target user ID, action type ('role_change'), old value, new value, timestamp (UTC, ISO 8601), and source IP.

Scenario: Failed authentication attempt by admin. Given an admin user, when they enter an incorrect password 3 times within 5 minutes, then an audit entry is created with action type 'failed_login' and subsequent attempts are blocked for 15 minutes.
Audit logs are append-only and cannot be modified or deleted by any user including super-admins.

Scenario: Query audit trail. Given I am a compliance auditor, when I query audit logs filtered by action type and date range, then the API returns paginated results (max 100 per page) with total count and next-page cursor.
Add a dark mode option.
Make sure it saves the user preference.
It should apply to all pages.
The toggle should be in the settings menu under 'Appearance'.

Scenario: Successful import. Given I upload a CSV file with headers 'email,role,department' and exactly 50 valid rows, when I click 'Import', then all 50 users are created, a success summary is shown ('50 users imported, 0 errors'), and a detailed import log is available for download.

Scenario: Partial import with errors. Given I upload a CSV where 45 of 50 rows are valid and 5 have invalid email formats, when I click 'Import', then only the 45 valid users are created, an error summary is shown ('45 users imported, 5 errors — see error report'), and the system never creates a partially-written user record.
Scenario: Empty file. Given I upload a CSV with only headers and no data rows, when I click 'Import', then the system rejects the file with message 'CSV file contains no data rows'.

Duplicate email detection: given two rows in the CSV with the same email address, when the import runs, the second occurrence is flagged as a duplicate and skipped, and the error report includes the row numbers of all duplicates.
Maximum file size: the system accepts CSV files up to 10 MB; files larger than 10 MB are rejected with message 'File exceeds 10 MB limit' before any processing begins.
Users can turn notifications on and off.
It should be easy to understand.
Be careful about the UI layout.
Work with the backend team to make sure it connects properly.

issues.summary: Re-scope Demo Data Cleanup (prod PII purging)
acceptanceCriteria: Delete all rows where created_at is older than 365 days from the users table in production (contains PII).
Run the purge between 02:00 and 04:00 UTC only.
Do not run without the on-call DBA present.
The purge must complete in under 30 minutes.
After the purge, delete the corresponding backup snapshots older than 400 days.
Implement the new billing API with usage-based metering, proration, and tax calculation.
Add SSO with SAML and OIDC for enterprise tenants.
Redesign the notification center with 5 new channels.
Add role-based access control for all new endpoints.
All old endpoints must be backward-compatible.
Add a migration for the billing schema and a migration for the auth schema.
Deploy to production behind a feature flag.
Everything must be covered by unit and integration tests.
